16.t: Working with data: hot-air balloon lift
q: What is the lift at 20 °C? Why?
0: inside and outside air have the same density.
Calculate the lift per m³ at 120 °C.
A balloon, basket and pilots have a mass of 600 kg. Calculate the volume needed at 100 °C.
Explain why balloon flights are usually early in the morning.
Cool morning air is denser, so the difference with the hot air is bigger: more lift for less fuel. Winds and thermals are also calmer.
